Biden-Harris Administration Actions to Protect Reproductive Rights
- Signed three Executive Orders to protect access to reproductive health care, including contraception
- Proposed a rule to expand access to over-the-counter contraception at no cost
- Expanded contraception coverage and affordability under the Affordable Care Act
- Strengthened HIPAA to safeguard patient and health care provider privacy  
- Expanded the Title X program to provide family planning care to millions of women
- Supported contraception coverage through the Medicaid and Medicare programs
- Promoted research and data analysis on contraception access
